'''"For the Republic" ''' was a popular [[Music/Legends|tune]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era.

==Behind the scenes==
"For the Republic" is background music heard in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It is the character creation theme from ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. Players can select it at the [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]] at [[Avilatan's Rest]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] using a jukebox token.
